conflict.message: Tasklerq: the item has already been changed in Tasklerq. Refresh and retry the action.

reauth_required.message: Tasklerq: reauthentication required. Update the integration token.

write_forbidden.message: The Tasklerq token cannot write: the ha:write scope is required.

not_found.message: The list or task was not found in Tasklerq. It may have been deleted; the list has been refreshed.

unavailable.message: Tasklerq is unavailable. Check the connection and try again.

write_failed.message: Failed to save changes to Tasklerq. Check the connection and try again.

capture_action_forbidden.message: The Tasklerq token cannot capture: the capture:write scope is required.

capture_action_reauth.message: Tasklerq: reauthentication required. Update the integration token.

capture_action_unavailable.message: Tasklerq is unavailable. Check the connection and try again.

capture_ambiguous_entry.message: Several Tasklerq integrations. Specify list_id from the lists of the required integration.

capture_conflict.message: Tasklerq is already processing this capture. Try again later. If the task did not appear, submit the text "{text}" again.

capture_disabled.message: The Tasklerq Capture API is disabled. The text "{text}" was not saved.

capture_failed.message: Failed to send the text "{text}" to Tasklerq. It may not have been saved: check the list and try again.

capture_forbidden.message: The Tasklerq token cannot capture: the capture:write scope is required. The text "{text}" was not saved.

capture_invalid.message: Tasklerq rejected the capture{reason}. The text "{text}" was not saved.

capture_llm_unavailable.message: Tasklerq could not parse the text: parsing is unavailable. The text "{text}" was not saved.

capture_not_configured.message: Tasklerq is not configured or not loaded. Add the Tasklerq integration.

capture_rate_limited.message: Too many capture requests to Tasklerq. Retry in {retry_after} s. The text "{text}" was not saved.

capture_reauth.message: Tasklerq: reauthentication required. The text "{text}" was not saved. Update the integration token.

capture_too_long.message: The capture text is too long. The text "{text}" was not saved.

capture_unavailable.message: Tasklerq is unavailable. The text "{text}" may not have been saved: check the list and try again.

cancel_capture_conflict.message: The capture has already been applied. Only a pending draft can be cancelled.

cancel_capture_not_found.message: The capture draft was not found in Tasklerq, or the Capture API is disabled.

confirm_capture_conflict.message: The capture draft has already been cancelled or cannot be confirmed.

confirm_capture_expired.message: The capture draft has expired (older than 15 minutes). Create a new draft.

confirm_capture_not_found.message: The capture draft was not found in Tasklerq, or the Capture API is disabled.

undo_capture_conflict.message: The items of the last capture have already been changed or cancelled; nothing was deleted.

undo_capture_disabled.message: The Capture API in Tasklerq is disabled.

undo_capture_unavailable.message: Tasklerq is unavailable. Failed to undo the last capture. Check the connection and try again.

calendar_too_old.message: Tasklerq provides calendar events no earlier than 2 years before today. Reduce the requested period.

calendar_rejected.message: Tasklerq could not provide the calendar: the period is too large or there are more than 1000 occurrences. Reduce the period.

calendar_forbidden.message: The Tasklerq token cannot read the calendar: the ha:read scope is required.

calendar_unavailable.message: Failed to connect to Tasklerq to load the calendar. Check the connection and try again.

calendar_failed.message: Failed to load Tasklerq calendar events. Check the connection and try again.

user.title: Connect to Tasklerq
user.description: Enter the Tasklerq server URL and API token. The token needs the ha:read scope, and for writing and capture — ha:write and capture:write.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthentication
reauth_confirm.description: The old Tasklerq token is no longer accepted. Enter a new token for this household.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to Tasklerq. Check the URL and server availability.
error.invalid_url: Invalid URL: enter an http:// or https:// address with a host name.
error.https_required: An HTTPS URL is required for addresses outside the local network. Use https:// in the Tasklerq URL.
error.missing_scope: The token lacks permissions: the ha:read scope is required, and for writing and capture — ha:write and capture:write.
error.household_not_found: Household not found. It may have been deleted.
error.unknown: Unknown Tasklerq error. Check the server address and try again.

abort.already_configured: The integration for this household is already configured.
abort.wrong_household: The new token belongs to another household. The current entry was not changed.
abort.reauth_successful: The Tasklerq token has been updated.
